title: Okilini-Sapattaṅgārakokiri
text: 1 Idhāham āvuso Gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasam itthim uppakkaṃ okiliniṃ okiriṇiṃ vehāsaṃ gacchantim || || Sāsudaṃ aṭṭassaraṃ karoti || || 2 Esā bhikkhave itthi Kaliṅgarañño aggamahesī ahosi || sā issāpakatā sapattim aṅgārakaṭāhena okiri || || Pañcamaṃ || ||
